title: Epipelagic Datum
body_html:
Epipelagic Datum

An epipelagic datum of order \(m\) for \(G\) is a triple \[ (x,\lambda,\chi) \] where \(x\) is an epipelagic point of order \(m\), \(\lambda\) is a stable vector in \(\mathbf g_{x,1/m}^\vee\), and \(\chi\) is a character of the finite stabilizer quotient \[ S_{x,\lambda}=H_{x,\lambda}/G_{x,1/m}. \]

The datum determines a character \(\psi_\lambda\) of \(G_{x,1/m}\), canonically extended to \(H_{x,\lambda}\), and gives the epipelagic supercuspidal representation \[ \pi_x(\lambda,\chi)=\operatorname{ind}_{H_{x,\lambda}}^G(\psi_\lambda\otimes \chi). \]
